info.name: Structura Integration Gateway
info.summary: Centrally manage JavaScript integrations for authenticated Nextcloud users
info.description:
## **Structura Integration Gateway**
Structura Integration Gateway provides a secure and lightweight way to centrally manage custom JavaScript integrations in Nextcloud.
Administrators can configure JavaScript through the Nextcloud administration settings. Configured integrations are loaded automatically for authenticated users while remaining disabled on login and unauthenticated pages.
### Key features
- Central management through Nextcloud administration settings - Available only to authenticated Nextcloud users - No JavaScript injection on login or public pages - Lightweight integration without additional background services
